text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t r-e-g-a-r-d-i-n-g t-h-e m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e a-n-d r-e-c-o-r-d e-n-t-r-y, l-e-f-t a t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t-o-n o-n f-i-l-e, a-n-d m-i-s-s-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s f-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g a-n-d f-a-l-s-i-f-y-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s, l-e-f-t a w-r-i-t-t-e-n a-s-k a-n-d a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e l-e-g-a-l a-n-d e-t-h-i-c-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-i-m-e-d t-o d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e t-h-e p-r-o-d-u-c-t t-h-r-o-u-g-h p-h-a-r-m-a-c-i-e-s, l-e-f-t a p-l-a-n n-o-t-e f-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-m-e-n-t, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d t-h-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d t-h-e c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t a g-a-p i-n t-h-e t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y l-o-g, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d t-h-e t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-o-u-g-h-t t-o a-v-o-i-d r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y i-n t-e-r-v-e-n-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e o-n e-v-a-s-i-o-n s-t-r-a-t-e-g-y, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-e-d t-h-e p-a-t-i-e-n-t s-a-f-e-t-y a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t.
